breathing.title: Calm Breath
breathing.subtitle: 4-7-8 rhythm to let cravings pass
breathing.instructReady: Tap the circle to begin 4-7-8 breath
breathing.subGuiding: Cycle {} of {} · Tap circle to stop
breathing.subIdle: Four cycles take 76 seconds to calm an urge
breathing.subCompleted: Well done! Tap the circle anytime to breathe again.
breathing.scienceBody: Inhaling for 4s, holding for 7s, and exhaling for 8s activates your vagus nerve and slows your heart rate—giving the craving wave time to pass.

health.title: Body Healing
health.subtitle: How your body repairs itself after quitting
health.emptyHealedSubtitle: Your body starts repairing itself within 20 minutes of your last cigarette.
health.m20mDesc: Your blood pressure and heart rate decrease.
health.m8hDesc: The carbon monoxide level in your blood returns to normal.
health.m24hDesc: Your chance of heart attack decreases.
health.m48hDesc: Your ability to taste and smell starts to return.
health.m5dDesc: The average number of cravings is reduced to 3 per day.
health.m10dDesc: Blood circulation in your gums and teeth returns to normal. Cravings are reduced to 2 per day (average).
health.m14dDesc: Your circulation improves and your lung function increases.
health.m21dDesc: Cessation-related anger, anxiety, restlessness, and depression have ended.
health.m2mDesc: Insulin resistance has normalized despite average weight gain of ~6 lb (2.7 kg).
health.m3mDesc: Coughing and shortness of breath decrease.
health.m1yDesc: Your risk of dying from heart disease is about half that of a smoker's.
health.m10yDesc: Your risk of lung cancer falls to about half that of a smoker's.
